frontier.hypothesis: An exit form exists that materialises the returned zero on the borrow (34) chassis WITHOUT introducing a long-lived ret pseudo, holding the target's exit shape and the sixth callee-save at the same time
frontier.mechanism: the s5 save comes from block-1/2 pressure exhausting the caller-save set in global.c find_reg; a function-scope ret pseudo spans block 1 and absorbs exactly that pressure, which is why the composed body drops back to five callee-saves. A carrier whose live range does NOT span block 1 (a second borrow of cross_center or center_x at the exits, or a ret declared inside a do { } while (0) wrap) would supply the zero without the span.

frontier.hypothesis: The remaining block-1 seat permutation on the 34 chassis is typable by tools/ra_solver now that the register multiset matches the target
